_readme: Display labels for the enum tokens of the ea-landscape method (English deliverables). Keys with a '_' prefix are texts used by tools. A key of the form '<token>_<ctx>' disambiguates the same token in different columns (ctx is set per column via label_ctx): '_p' = provided by, '_q' = extraction quality. The engine's own labels for 'standard' and 'client' (the two reviewers) are therefore never overwritten.
unresolvable: cannot be settled from the documents
_diagram_legend_asis: As-is landscape in the valantic legend: one box per system in three lanes (experience and channels, integration and data, systems of record); box fill and border = lifecycle status; arrow style = integration style; every arrow carries its flow id, data objects, frequency and middleware from the flow list. Star = single source of truth for the listed data objects, warning sign = mastership claimed by more than one system. Picture and workbooks always show the same rows.
_diagram_legend_target: Target landscape in the valantic legend: green = new, orange = to be replaced or consolidated, hatched = retiring, blue dashed = capability decided, product open, grey = kept. Thick arrows are the flows the options change; faded arrows stay unchanged. Generated from the option list - a changed option changes the picture.
_marker_ssot: single source of truth for the listed data objects
_marker_conflict: mastership claimed by more than one system (client decision)
_diagram_legend_target_arrows: Thick arrows: flows an option changes; faded arrows: unchanged.
